## Acceptance #3 — defect-1 remedy chosen: ROUTE the call site, do NOT regen the snapshot

Read of the call site settles the body's open question. scripts/issue2223_r5_pubtopic.py:206-225
(fig5_cjk_scan) is a genuinely NEW, genuinely UNROUTED call: a one-shot download of a single JSON
at a pinned revision, inside a cache-miss branch, with no retry wrapper anywhere in the
expression. It is not a pre-existing file whose frozen snapshot went stale, so the #1568
snapshot-regen escape does not apply — a regen would bless the bare call and permanently retire
the check's coverage of it.

Remedy: wrap the call in the canonical helper. hub.retry_transient is an alias of _retry_upload
(orchestrate/hub.py:1404); documented call shape retry_transient(lambda: <hub call>, what="<label>").
The lint's wrap predicate (_hf_routing_call_is_wrapped) accepts a wrap that opens on the call's own
line before it, or within 3 lines above while its expression is still paren-open — the lambda shape
satisfies the latter. HF_ROUTING_WRAP_RE matches bare `retry_transient(` and dotted
`hub.retry_transient(` alike.

Consequence for the 4th red node: test_regen_hf_routing_snapshot_live_tree_subset_of_current goes
green WITHOUT touching the frozen snapshot, because once the live tree has zero offenders the
regen output is trivially a subset of the current snapshot.

## Defect-2 remedy — import ordering only (acceptance #4)

Per file: move the sys.path bootstrap up, import and CALL load_dotenv() before the first heavy
import, and keep every existing import with its noqa: E402. No logic, no behavior change — these
are already-run analysis drivers for a promoted #2223 result. Note r3_domain_ci has no `import sys`
and no sys.path bootstrap today (it reaches explore_persona_space transitively via its sibling
import), so it needs the bootstrap added, not merely reordered.

Blessing the violations by adding the four files to GRANDFATHERED_TORCH_BEFORE_DOTENV is the
rejected alternative — the same "retire the coverage" failure mode as the snapshot regen, and it
would contradict acceptance #4.
